verdict.rationale: Phaser documents an official "Phaser Game Agent MCP server" that lets users build games from their existing editor, and Phaser Editor's MCP server offers 40+ tools that integrate with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients. A runtime probe confirms the official hosted MCP endpoint at phaser.io/agent/mcp, though no standalone npm MCP package exists. Missing for 10: detailed connection/setup and auth documentation, independent community or hands-on corroboration of agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Build games from inside the editor you already use with the Phaser Game Agent MCP server.
It implements over 40 specialised tools and integrates directly with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP-compatible tools.
You describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you.
official MCP server documented at https://phaser.io/agent/mcp
